items.title: Two Beximco firms get BB lifeline to keep business going
items.description: The Bangladesh Bank (BB) has relaxed lending restrictions for two loan-defaulting companies of the Beximco Group to help them maintain regular business operations.

items.title: Bankers get five-day break for Durga Puja
items.description: Banks will remain closed from October 20 to 22 on the occasion of Durga Puja, followed by the regular weekend on October 23 and 24, giving bankers a five-day break.
